audience: Decodex operators auditing the X Publisher automation
text: Decodex publisher live test (2026-06-02): verifying @decodexspace Chrome account verification, compose, post submit, final URL readback, and social_post/v1 persistence. This low-frequency test post may be deleted after validation.
evidence_notes: Chrome readback on https://x.com/home verified the active account display as Decodex @decodexspace before composition.
The test post was composed through the X web composer and submitted from the @decodexspace session.
The final permalink was read back from the timeline DOM and then verified by opening the permalink directly.
Chrome file chooser media upload returned Not allowed before publication, so this live test intentionally validated text-only publishing and records media upload as a remaining caveat.

claims.text: The @decodexspace Chrome publication path can verify account state, compose, submit, and read back a published X permalink.
The live test persisted its result as a social_post/v1 record for later automation audit.

decision.reason: Operator explicitly authorized a controlled live X publication test to verify the automated Publisher path.

caveats: No generated image was attached because Chrome file chooser upload failed with Not allowed in the live test environment.
X displayed an Unlock more on X account notice after submit; the post permalink is still readable, but account reach or trust limits may be platform-gated.
Manual Chrome tab cleanup calls timed out after publication readback; later Publisher automation runs should still close or release scoped tabs before terminal reporting.
The test post is intentionally public and may be deleted by the operator after validation.
